title: Resize Git timeline and changed-file pane
body:
Add a draggable vertical divider between the Git History timeline and the right-hand changed-file/details pane (src/git_history.rs, currently hard-coded 0.55 split). Preserve the existing changed-files/commit-details divider (src/git_history/details.rs). See docs/git-history.md.

Decisions:
- Store the details pane width in unscaled px (divide by view scale s) on HistoryView, not as a fraction: window growth goes to the timeline, and zoom scales the pane.
- Clamp when drawing only; write the stored width back only on drag, so shrinking and then regrowing the window restores the chosen width.
- Set the position from interact_pointer_pos, not by adding pointer.delta() (that drifts after hitting a clamp). Leave the old divider's delta math alone.
- Drag area is the whole gap, centered on the line (+/-6px scaled), with the ResizeHorizontal cursor and the same th.dim/th.border hover swap.
- Details minimum is about 220px scaled, capped at half the body width. The timeline already scrolls horizontally.
- The width survives commit selection and Refresh. It is NOT saved across restart (ContentSnap stays identity-only).
- Hand-rolled divider, not SidePanel::show_inside (that ignores zoom and risks duplicate Ids across Projects).

Test: drag, shrink the window, regrow it, assert the width is restored. Mirror divider_drags_and_commit_changes_clear_file_selection.
